headline: Anthropic seeks up to $3.5 billion in Japan ahead of planned US IPO
summary: AI startup Anthropic is seeking up to US$3.5 billion in Japan ahead of its planned US initial public offering, granting Japan direct access to the deal.
why: Anthropic is a major artificial intelligence developer backed by tech giants; large pre-IPO funding rounds reflect continued institutional appetite for leading generative AI firms.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Anthropic is raising capital in Japan ahead of a targeted mega initial public offering.
